value: Winning the game

name: englishlocalization
value: The first player to walk all four tokens across the board and reach the end is the winner.

name: englishlocalization
value: Moving out of the nest

name: englishlocalization
value: A token can come out of the nest when player rolls 5 in a single dice or the sum of two dice. Two tokens can come out when player rolls double 5.

name: englishlocalization
value: Punishment of rolling three consecutive double

name: englishlocalization
value: Player will get another chance of rolling the dice when they roll double. If player roll double three times in a single turn then third roll is invalid and the most advanced token will be sent back to nest (Token in ending track can't be sent back).

name: englishlocalization
value: Blockade

name: englishlocalization
value: If two tokens of the same color stay in the same box then they form a blockade. Neither the player's token or opponents' token can cross blockade. If a player can't move any token because of blockade then this turn is invalid. Note: If the player rolls double then it is forced to break blockade.

name: englishlocalization
value: Safety zone

name: englishlocalization
value: All gray spaces with star are safety zones. Token in safety zones can't be captured.

name: englishlocalization
value: Staying at safety zone

name: englishlocalization
value: Two tokens with different colors can't stay in one safety zone at the same time.
